principles.status: Feature definitions/crosswalk considered; no positive implementation from a principle mapping alone.

scope_choices: Full bibliography entries on pages 22–26 were subsequently read in the targeted 2026-11-22 local review; cited full studies remain unretrieved. Case-study results (neuropathology, recycling, Etalumis, causal diagnosis, CAMS) are cited work and are not inherited as capabilities of MLTRL or of any world model.

The framework is not healthcare-specific and has no world-model content. Feature assertions are at the level of the framework's own process requirements and its recommendations, kept at claim or specification stage. They show what the framework asks for, not that a system satisfies it.

No measured evaluation of MLTRL's benefits is reported, so the author statement that it is proven rests on narrated examples. The TRL Card templates are promised at publication and were not available.
